xmldoc.short_description: Points on a small ellipse on a sphere.

syntax.syntax_item: [lat, lon] = ellipse1(lat0, lon0, ellipse, offset, npts)

param_input_item.param_description: latitude of the ellipse center, in degrees.
longitude of the ellipse center, in degrees.
two-element vector [semimajor eccentricity]; the semimajor axis is a spherical distance in degrees of arc.
azimuth of the semimajor axis, in degrees (default 0).
number of points used to trace the ellipse (default 100).

param_output_item.param_description: latitudes of the ellipse boundary points, in degrees.
longitudes of the ellipse boundary points, in degrees.

description.p: ellipse1 returns the latitude and longitude of points tracing a small ellipse on a sphere, centered at (lat0, lon0). The ellipse is described by its semimajor axis (a spherical distance in degrees of arc) and its eccentricity. A zero eccentricity produces a small circle whose radius equals the semimajor axis. The boundary points are obtained with reckon, so the first and last points coincide.
